==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32}}
;1. b) Holster Speed Buffs & Mod Changes

These changes to Ammo encourage swapping between weapons, so we’ve taken the opportunity to dramatically increase the swapping speed between Primary and Secondary. The real purpose of your Secondary weapon is for it to be a backup to your Primary, but with the holster speeds the way they were before that vision was not realized - until now! 

In light of the overall speed buff to holster speed, we have made the following changes to the mods and Arcanes that offered holster speed stat increases: 

'''''(All stats below are shown at max rank)'''''

Reflex Draw (Conclave): 

*Removed their holster rate increase. 
*They now apply -40% Weapon Recoil and -40% spread for 8s on equip.

{{ver|26}}
*Now an Exilus Weapon mod.

{{ver|17.9}}
*The following Conclave Mods can now be used in PvE:
**Reflex Draw / Twitch / Soft Hands (Pistol/Rifle/Shotgun) - Increased Holster/Draw speed.

{{ver|16}}
*Introduced.
}}

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|A finely tuned instrument of assassination.}} The '''Rakta Cernos''' is a modified {{Weapon|Cernos}} bow exclusively available to the {{Faction|Red Veil}}. It features the fastest charge time of all bows, increased base damage, and innate [[Blight]] effect, at the expense of slightly lower [[critical chance]] and [[status chance]]. ==Characteristics== This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage. {{Advantages|class=Bow|* Innate [[Blight]] effect.}} {{Disadvantages|class=Bow|* Innate Blight effect can put enemies into minor alert status during stealth.}} {{WeaponComparison|Cernos}} {{WeaponComparison|Cernos Prime|header=n}} ==Acquisition== *The Rakta Cernos can be acquired by reaching the Rank of '''Exalted''' with the {{Faction|Red Veil}}, and spending {{sc|125,000}} to purchase. As with all Syndicate Weapons, the Rakta Cernos cannot be chosen as the free offering upon ranking up to Exalted rank. *Syndicate weapons can also be acquired via [[Trade System|Trading]], but only for unranked copies without [[Forma]] and [[Orokin Catalyst]] installed. *Players must have a [[Mastery Rank]] of at least 12 to acquire the Rakta Cernos, either through trading or through the Syndicates themselves. ==Notes== *Has a unique holster style where the bow is upside down on the Warframe's back instead of being slung across its shoulder. ==Trivia== *The word "{{Tooltip|Rakta|RUK-thuh}}" can be traced back to the Sanskrit language, meaning "blood" or "coloured". It means the same in many other Indic languages derived from Sanskrit / Prakrit - like Marathi, Hindi etc. ==Media== Syndicateweapons5803.jpg|The Rakta Cernos (left) alongside the {{Weapon|Rakta Ballistica}} (right) as seen on [[Devstream 58]]. Rakta Cernos (1).png|Rakta Cernos as it appears in the arsenal Rakta Cernos Quiver.png|The arrow quiver for Rakta Cernos Rakta Cernos (2).png| {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|ZwaEJXfKOG4|size=300px}} |{{YouTube|ni7Rr36BQdM|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32}} ;Ammo Changes We understand the power fantasy of these weapons is very popular for some, so our first approach was to keep them powerful, but limit how often they can be used by making changes to ammo pick-up. '''''Ammo Pickup Overrides'''''
The following weapons now have ammo pickup overrides, meaning they gain less from picking up ammo. This mostly applies to AoE weapons, in hopes that players will become more deliberate with their aim to make the most of their Ammo pools. The following lists the specific ammo pick up overrides per weapon category. '''Primary Weapon Ammo Pick Up Overrides''' 15 Ammo per Pick Up: *Rakta Cernos {{ver|25.7}} *Normalized quick shots to have the same critical chance/damage and status chance as charged shots. *While reviewing Bow stats the team has also refreshed all their FX (including the Lenz)! *Quick Shot increased from 150 to 235 *Charged Shot increased from 250 to 470 {{ver|17.3}} *Introduced. }} ==See Also== *{{Weapon|Cernos}}, the normal counterpart. *{{Weapon|Cernos Prime}}, the [[Prime]]d counterpart. *{{Weapon|Mutalist Cernos}}, the [[Infested]] counterpart. *{{Weapon|Proboscis Cernos}}, another Infested counterpart. *{{Weapon|Rakta Ballistica}}, the secondary weapon associated with Red Veil. *{{Weapon|Rakta Dark Dagger}}, the melee weapon associated with Red Veil. *{{Faction|Red Veil}}, the [[Syndicate]] that offers this weapon. *[[Syndicate Weapons]], for other weapons from the Syndicates. {{WeaponNav}} [[de:Rakta Cernos]] [[es:Cernos Rakta]] [[Category:Tenno]] [[Category:Silent]] [[Category:Bow]] [[Category:Weapons]] [[Category:Primary Weapons]] [[Category:Impact Damage Weapons]] [[Category:Special Weapons]] [[Category:Syndicate Offerings]] [[Category:Update 17]] [[Category:Single-Shot]] [[Category:Syndicate Weapons]] [[uk:Цернос-ракта]]

{{Top|Lotus|Tenno|Tenno|Weapon|Weapons|Weapons}} {{For|the Grineer units|Regulator}}
Vanilla={{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic|name=Regulators}} |-|Prime={{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic|name=Regulators Prime}}
The '''Regulators''' are {{WF|Mesa}} and {{WF|Mesa Prime}}'s signature [[Exalted Weapon]], summoned by activating the ability {{A|Peacemaker}}. Unlike other ranged weapons, the rapid-firing Regulators will automatically target and shoot at enemies within a large aiming circle directed by the player, removing the need for precise aim.
==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Impact}} damage. *Innate two {{Pol|Naramon}} and one {{Pol|Madurai}} polarities. *Fires in 2-round bursts. Damage and [[fire rate]] ramp up for each burst fired. **Ramp up damage bonus increments from '''+7.5%''' on the first two-round burst to a maximum of '''+150%''' after 20 bursts. ***This bonus is multiplicative to final damage, and resets when exiting {{A|Peacemaker}}. **A fractional multiplier is applied to fire rate, with a minimum value of '''0.25x''', ramping up to '''1.0x''' after 20 bursts. ***This multiplier is reset to its minimum value upon exiting {{A|Peacemaker}}, releasing the fire button, and when Peacemaker goes 2 seconds without firing. ***This effect is multiplied against all other modifiers to fire rate. *Innate damage bonus from {{WF|Mesa}}'s {{Stat|Ability Strength}}. **Value of the damage bonus is {{Stat|Ability Strength|icon=only}} '''150%''', and stacks additively with damage mods like {{M|Hornet Strike}}. **With the bonus from {{A|Shooting Gallery}} the Regulators can be expected to receive a sum {{Stat|Ability Strength|icon=only}} '''175%''' additive damage bonus from {{WF|Mesa}}'s abilities. *See {{A|Peacemaker}} for more details. '''Advantages''' *Very high [[critical chance]] and [[critical multiplier]]. *Very high [[fire rate]] of 14.80. **This figure indicates the fire rate at maximum ramp up, which is attained after 20 two-round bursts have been fired. *Pinpoint [[accuracy]]. **Lowering the accuracy of Regulators via {{M|Magnum Force}} will not affect the placement of shots. *Has infinite ammunition and does not need to reload. '''Disadvantages''' *Low [[status chance]]. *Limited range of '''50''' meters. *Before ramp up, has only a modest base fire rate of 3.70. *Restricted method of aiming. *User cannot move while active unless equipped with {{M|Mesa's Waltz}}. *Most [[Exilus Mods]] effects are not applicable and/or their requirements cannot be met (except {{M|Suppress}}, which does reduce the [[Noise Level]] stat). **{{M|Reflex Draw}}, ({{M|Primed Steady Hands|Primed}}){{M|Steady Hands}}, {{M|Strafing Slide}}: Regulators have no recoil and perfect accuracy. **({{M|Primed Pistol Ammo Mutation|Primed}}){{M|Pistol Ammo Mutation}}, {{M|Trick Mag}}: Regulators don't use ammo. **{{M|Lethal Momentum}}: Regulators are [[hitscan]] weapons and don't fire projectiles. **{{M|Energizing Shot}}: Regulators cannot shoot Energy Orbs. **{{M|Air Recon}}, {{M|Hawk Eye}}, {{M|Spry Sights}}, {{M|Targeting Subsystem}}: Regulators cannot zoom. *Since Regulators cannot zoom, they also cannot benefit from {{M|Embedded Catalyzer}}, {{M|Hydraulic Crosshairs}}, {{M|Pressurized Magazine}}, or {{M|Sharpened Bullets}}. *Requires energy to activate and keep active. ==Notes== *The Regulators appear in the [[Arsenal]] after unlocking Mesa's {{A|Peacemaker}} ability. *The displayed damage number of '''125''' in the Arsenal is the Regulators' base damage of '''50''' boosted by Peacemaker's innate '''+150%''' damage bonus. **When in the [[Sanctuary (Cephalon Simaris)#Simulacrum|Simulacrum]], the arsenal display may be glitched and instead show the Regulators' damage without the multiplier. **When in the [[Sanctuary (Cephalon Simaris)#Simulacrum|Simulacrum]], the Regulators are bugged to have their innate 150% base damage bonus applied twice, making them deal noticeably more damage than in actual missions. The Regulators' 150% multiplicative damage bonus as they spool up is applied properly, however. *The ammunition related statistics displayed (such as magazine size, ammunition pool and reload speed) are merely a technical formality of the stat preview screen as the weapon actually consumes 0 bullets per shot, thus allowing infinite ammo economy. This also means that mods that benefit ammunition (such as mods that increase reload speed or mag capacity) are effectively useless. *As an Exalted Weapon, this weapon comes with an {{Resource|Orokin Catalyst}} pre-installed. *Being dual pistols, the {{Weapon|Furax}}-exclusive {{M|Amalgam Furax Body Count}}'s fire rate boost works with the Regulators. ==Trivia== *The name of the Regulators might be a reference to the [[wikipedia:Lincoln County Regulators|Regulators]], a posse from the American Old West said to have been co-founded by [[wikipedia:Billy the Kid|Billy the Kid]]. *Before the introduction of moddable [[Exalted Weapon]]s, the stats of Regulators were affected by the mods equipped on the player's Secondary weapon. *The Regulators Presidio Skin can be equipped regardless of whether or not the Mesa Presidio Skin is equipped. *On {{WF|Mesa Prime}}, the pistols are named {{Weapon|Regulators Prime}}. Their stats are, however, identical to Regulators. ==Media== {{VideoGallery |{{YouTube|VreYA1laNJw|size=300px}} }} {{SkinGallery}} ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|41.0.3}} *Fixed Zid-An Uskos' heat buff not applying to Exalted Secondary Weapons. {{ver|39.1}} *Fixed Arcane Velocity's fire rate bonus being doubled for Peacemaker when equipped on (non-Prime) Mesa. {{ver|29.5}} *Fixed de-equipping a Scanner not returning you to your active Exalted weapon if one was equipped prior. {{ver|29.1.1}} *Fixes towards Exalted weapons not being equipped when viewed via Look Link or Mod Link. {{ver|23.8}} *Removed ability to unintentionally equip Hydraulic Crosshairs and Sharpened Bullets on Mesa’s Regulators. Although the buff appeared to trigger, it never actually applied due to the "on aim" criteria not being fulfilled (unless you had a very specific loadout with the Mesa Waltz Augment equipped). {{ver|23.0.4}} *Fixed Mesa Regulator upgrades being applied twice for Clients. {{ver|23}} *Introduced as a moddable weapon. }} {{ver/Lu|23.10.8}} ==See Also== *{{A|Peacemaker}}, the ability that summons the weapon. *{{WF|Mesa}}, the weapon's user. {{WeaponNav}} [[es:Reguladoras]] [[de:Regulatoren]] [[fr:Pacificateurs]] [[Category:Exalted Weapon]] [[Category:Mesa]] [[Category:Dual Pistols]] [[Category:Update 23]] [[Category:Dual Sidearms]] [[uk:Упорядники]] [[uk:Упорядники]]

{{WeaponInfoboxAutomatic}} {{Codex|Kullervo’s signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.}} '''Rauta''' is {{WF|Kullervo}}'s [[Signature Weapon|signature]] shotgun. Sporting a high [[Multishot]] and [[Reload Speed]], but low [[Critical Chance]], [[Fire Rate]], and [[Magazine Size]], Rauta also uniquely increases the equipped melee weapon's [[Melee Combo]] Count with each pellet that lands on an enemy. In Kullervo's hands, his melee Combo Duration increases. ==Characteristics== *This weapon deals primarily {{D|Slash}} damage. *Each pellet adds '''2''' [[Melee Combo]] Count. **Total combo count gain for one shot has a cap of '''28''', achievable with '''+70%''' [[Multishot]]. ***This cap "floats" over to the next shot, and resets once the total combo gained by Rauta reaches '''+28'''. For example, when modded with only {{M|Vigilante Armaments}} (12.8 total multishot), Rauta will gain up to '''26''' combo per shot. The next shot afterwards can only gain '''+2''' combo. *Landing pellets onto more enemies with [[Punch Through]] does not increase combo count. *When equipped by {{WF|Kullervo}}, his melee weapon gains '''+7s''' Melee Combo Duration. {{Advantages|class=Shotgun| }} {{Disadvantages|class=Shotgun| }} ==Acquisition== ===Limited Time Event=== In the first two weeks after '''The Seven Crimes of Kullervo''' launched (June 21st, 2023 @ 12 PM ET until July 5th, 2023 @ 12 PM ET), entering [[Duviri]] via the [[Star Chart]] banner and [[Dormizone]] door would present all players with an event mission called '''Kullervo's Hold''', which was based on The Lone Story's spiral-focused gameplay and always included the dungeon island in the Duviri [[Landscape]] regardless of the current Mood Spiral. This limited-time access required 5 {{Resource|Pathos Clamp|Pathos Clamps}}. ===Normal Progression=== Kullervo's Hold only appears in Duviri during Anger, Sorrow, and Fear Spirals from [[The Duviri Experience]] and [[The Lone Story]] game modes. It can appear as a fourth, fifth, or sixth spiral stage or a side objective; speak with [[The Warden]] to engage in gladiatorial combat with the imprisoned Kullervo in the waterlogged arena. Completion of the Spiral (defeating the [[Orowyrm]]) and defeating Kullervo awards 4, 5, or 6 {{Resource|Kullervo's Bane}} (6, 7, or 8 on [[The Steel Path]]), which can be traded to [[File:IconDuviriAcrithis.png|30x30px]][[Acrithis]] for Rauta's main blueprint and components: the main blueprint requires 12 Banes, while the Barrel, Receiver, and Stock components each require 6 Banes, for a total of 30 Kullervo's Banes. ==Crafting== {{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon|name=Rauta}} ==Notes== *The Rauta will only build combo for [[Exalted Weapon|Exalted Melee Weapons]] if they are active. ==Tips== *Players opting to use the Rauta's combo gain can use mods that reduce spread such as {{M|Double-Barrel Drift}}, {{M|Narrow Barrel}}, or {{M|Tainted Shell}} to make the Rauta more accurate and thus more likely to boost or maintain combo at longer ranges. The falloff stat will make the weapon do minimal damage, but using the Rauta for this purpose makes the low damage at range a moot point. *Fire rate mods and the {{M|Lock and Load}} mod greatly enhance the weapon's utility, allowing the player to quickly build up combo with minimal interference to melee combat. ==Trivia== *''[[wiktionary:rauta#Noun|Rauta]]'' is the Finnish word for "iron". *The Rauta is a single-barrel, break action shotgun, but it uses a mechanism based on the [https://www.forgottenweapons.com/alofs-a-steampunk-mousetrap-for-a-shotgun/ Alofs reloading magazine] to hold three more rounds. **The Alofs reloading magazine is a cylinder installed on the side of the shotgun, feeding in a new shell via the use of springs when the previous one was ejected. This is reflected in the Rauta's firing animation where the Warframe breaks open the action, with the spent round being ejected and an arm quickly moving into position to reload the Rauta, returning to the cylinder afterward. **Whereas all surviving Alofs magazines were mounted on the left side of the shotgun, the Rauta's magazine is mounted on the right side. *The design of the Rauta's stock is likely inspired by the unique stocks of [[wikipedia:jezail|jezail]] rifles. ==Bugs== *When paired with a melee that can go beyond the 12x combo multiplier limit (e.g. [[Venka Prime]]) it will reset it back to 12x combo upon landing a pellet. *The barrel may glitch out and rotate when reloading if the reload is fast enough. *The glowing tracer rounds follow where the barrel is pointed, so firing before the weapon is straight will cause them to fire toward the ground.
